target: original observed ratings 1..5; no negative sampling, no score clipping
implicit_history: all observed fit items, including the rated target in fit, normalized by sqrt(history size); frozen at query
time: UTC integer Unix days; fit-only per-user mean; dev=sign((day-mean)/365.25)*abs((day-mean)/365.25)^beta
item_bins: equal-width over fit min_day..max_day inclusive; queries outside fit range clipped to nearest edge bin
unseen_user_day: day bias and day factor are zero for unobserved (user, day); no extrapolation of day effects
loss: one half mean squared rating error + regularization/2 times per-observation active-parameter squared norms; implicit Y penalty averages squared history coefficients
optimizer: exact full-gradient AdaGrad, one full-data step per epoch, epsilon 1e-8; H@Y and H.T@g exact, no stale-epoch history approximation
selection: maximum validation macro NDCG@10 at fixed stage query time after all 50 epochs
tie_break: fewer factors, then fewer bins, then larger regularization
temporal_ablation: one additional static SVD++ run with selected hyperparameters, temporal terms disabled; diagnostic only, not separately tuned
